entry.name: region
entry.label: Data centre of the Deye Cloud account: eu, us, india or custom

entry.name: customUrl
entry.label: Address of the API when region is custom

entry.name: login
entry.label: Email or username of the Deye Cloud account

entry.name: passwordHash
entry.label: SHA-256 of the password, kept only while rememberPassword is on; never the password itself

entry.name: companyId
entry.label: Only for business accounts

entry.name: tokenExpiresAt
entry.label: Seconds since 1970

entry.name: stationId
entry.label: Empty until a station is picked; a String because the ids are 64-bit

entry.name: idleBelow
entry.label: Watts under which a line of the graph shows no flow

entry.name: lowBattery
entry.label: Percent under which the battery is drawn as low

entry.name: batteryCapacity
entry.label: Capacity of the battery in kWh; 0 takes it from what the inverter reports

entry.name: batteryReserve
entry.label: Percent under which the inverter no longer draws from the battery

entry.name: showForecast
entry.label: Estimate the production of today and tomorrow from the forecast of solar radiation

entry.name: forecastHost
entry.label: Where the forecast of solar radiation is asked for; not shown in the settings

entry.name: notifyBattery
entry.label: Notify when the battery falls under lowBattery

entry.name: notifySilent
entry.label: Notify when the station stops reporting

entry.name: notifyAlerts
entry.label: Notify when the station raises a new alert

entry.name: priceBuy
entry.label: What a kilowatt-hour from the grid costs; 0 hides the money

entry.name: priceSell
entry.label: What a kilowatt-hour sent to the grid brings

entry.name: language
entry.label: auto, ro or en

entry.name: fontScale
entry.label: Percent of the font size of the Plasma theme

entry.name: fontFamily
entry.label: Empty for the font of the Plasma theme

entry.name: powerUnit
entry.label: auto, w or kw

entry.name: background
entry.label: black, theme or none

entry.name: animations
entry.label: full, reduced or off

entry.name: hiddenTabs
entry.label: Ids of the tabs that are turned off: flow, day, history, balance, alerts, device

entry.name: compactItems
entry.label: What the panel shows: battery, solar, load, grid
